description: ADR-080 sidecar manifest. Each entry justifies one versioned agent model pin with a committed sweep artifact. Skills and commands may never appear here (they cannot be swept). Fields per entry: unit (repo-relative path), model (versioned id the pin uses), decision (must be KEEP_PIN), artifact (repo-relative sweep JSON path), fixtures_sha, default_model (the harness default the sweep compared against), date (YYYY-MM-DD the sweep ran). Evidence older than 180 days is stale. Empty until the ~17 fixture-backed agents are swept in the migration.
